title: hnRNPs: roles in neurodevelopment and implication for brain disorders
abstract: Heterogeneous nuclear ribonucleoproteins (hnRNPs) constitute a family of multifunctional RNA-binding proteins able to process nuclear pre-mRNAs into mature mRNAs and regulate gene expression in multiple ways. They comprise at least 20 different members in mammals, named from A ( HNRNP A1 ) to U ( HNRNP U ).
